_metadata.source: Published IDSP weekly surveillance analysis (Indian Journal of Community Medicine, 2024); WHO Global Health Observatory; BMC Medical Informatics 2026 bed-occupancy study
_metadata.description: Calibration parameters for seasonal disease curves and operational volatility used by the seed's synthetic data generator. These numbers are derived from real epidemiological literature.

malaria_dengue_seasonality.description: 63-80% of malaria outbreaks occur in H2 (post-monsoon). Dengue peaks in Sept-Nov. Modeled as Gaussian centered on day-of-year 285 with sigma=35.
malaria_dengue_seasonality.citation: Sharma RK et al. Seasonal pattern analysis of malaria outbreaks in India using IDSP data (2020-2023). Indian J Community Med. 2024;49(2):312-318.

gi_outbreak_seasonality.description: GI/waterborne outbreaks peak pre-monsoon (May-June) when water sources are stressed. Modeled as Gaussian centered on day-of-year 135 with sigma=30.
gi_outbreak_seasonality.citation: IDSP weekly outbreak reports (www.idsp.nic.in); WHO SEARO waterborne disease factsheet

dengue_india_annual_trend.description: National dengue case counts from NVBDCP/NCVBDC reports. Used to calibrate outbreak magnitude in the seed.
dengue_india_annual_trend.citation: National Centre for Vector Borne Diseases Control (NCVBDC), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, India

bed_occupancy_dynamics.description: Calibration bounds for bed occupancy volatility. Mean ~45%, SD ~10% in non-outbreak steady state, up to 90%+ during outbreaks.
bed_occupancy_dynamics.citation: Rashwan W et al. Hospital bed occupancy forecasting using ARIMA and ML models. BMC Med Inform Decis Mak. 2026;26:18. | Sahu SK et al. Bed occupancy prediction in an Indian hospital. Sci Rep. 2025;15:4422.

supply_chain_parameters.description: Lead time and supply failure rate parameters grounded in published Indian public health logistics studies.
supply_chain_parameters.citation: Indian public health supply chain assessment reports (MoHFW); WHO Essential Medicines logistics guidelines
